definitions.scope: Three independently initialized seed repeats; native VAL at common final update; no new TEST evaluation
definitions.score_units: Fractions; percentage-point deltas equal raw score delta times100
definitions.delta: to minus from, paired on the same seed and case; undefined metrics stay null
definitions.variance: Population SD across defined cases; no claim about patient independence
definitions.worst20: ceil(20% of defined cases), smallest for scores and largest for FP/FN; other count/volume tails descriptive
definitions.fine: GT native Lee skeleton with physical native EDT radius<=2mm; no supported sites gives null recall
definitions.partial: Partial exports are explicitly incomplete; failed/missing measurements are never imputed as zero
definitions.evaluation_erratum: Explicit certified external evaluation; original failed pipeline status and artifacts preserved. Training, model and prediction voxel arrays unchanged.
